public_health_question.v: How has the WHO African Region progressed in transitioning vaccine-preventable disease surveillance data management from Epi Info to the DHIS2 platform, and what challenges remain?

ev.q: This report describes the phased transition from Epi Info to DHIS2 IDSR and case-based surveillance packages in WHO African Region countries during 2019–2023
District Health Information Software 2 for Vaccine-Preventable Disease Surveillance

equity.level_reason: The report describes an information-system transition across countries; no social-position dimension is analyzed or framed.

notes: The only quantities are counts of countries at each stage of software implementation (29 IDSR nationwide, 8 case-based fully implemented, 2 transferring data); these are program-process counts, not public health outcomes, so data_focus is none. A reader treating implementation counts as data would choose limited with summary/binary-categorical.
